routes.sub_description:

During weekends (Saturday through Sunday, 8:30 a.m. - 12:00 a.m.), the C route operates on a fixed schedule.

routes.name: Emory National Biomedical Research Center (ENBRC)
routes.description: For questions about Emory shuttles, including routes, schedules, or lost & found, please call 404-727-1829
routes.sub_description:
The ENBRC shuttle is operated directly by the Emory National Biomedical Research Center and is not part of Transportation and Parking Services.

The shuttle runs approximately every 20 minutes with the 1st departure from the ENBRC at 6:50am and the last departure from the ENBRC at 5:50pm.

This service replaced the on-call shuttle service, however, operators can be reached by calling (404) 783-7803.

* 5:10, 5:30, & 5:50 trips do not stop at 1599 Clifton Road.

routes.name: SafeRide
routes.sub_description:
SafeRide is a free, on-demand service that operates on Emory’s Clifton campuses from 9PM-5AM, 365 days per year. An Emory Shuttle vehicle provides the service. Rides may be scheduled in advance.

REQUEST A RIDE FROM ANYWHERE ON CAMPUS, TO ANYWHERE ON CAMPUS!


Riders may request a ride via the TripShot mobile app (Android | Apple), emory.tripshot.com, or by phone at 404-727-7555

routes.name: CCTMA
routes.sub_description:
This route connects Emory's main campus to downtown Decatur, serving stops on Clifton Road, North Decatur Road, and Clairmont Road.

The CCTMA shuttle is funded by the Clifton Corridor Transportation Management Association. Member organizations that support this service include Emory (University & Healthcare), the CDC, CHOA, the City of Decatur, Ben Franklin Academy, and the University Inn.

CCTMA riders are encouraged to utilize the MARTA Route #15 bus connecting the Decatur station to Lindbergh Station and serving Ben Franklin Academy, City of Decatur, Centers for Disease Control, Emory Conference Center Hotel, Emory University, Emory Healthcare, The Emory Inn, and Wesley Woods, with connecting service to Children's Healthcare of Atlanta via the MARTA Route #11 Bus

Emory University & Emory Healthcare provide subsidized MARTA & Xpress transit passes for eligible employees. Find more information and apply here: https://transportation.emory.edu/commute-resources

Live CCTMA route map

routes.sub_description:

Buses travel along Defoor Avenue, Northside Drive, 10th Street, Virginia Avenue, Clifton Road and Briarcliff Road, serving Georgia Tech, Piedmont Park, Emory University, Emory University Hospital, CDC and Children’s Healthcare of Atlanta.
